_about: The 30 realistic test messages for the translation test (P3). Mixed English, isiZulu and isiXhosa, the way people really text. Each lists what must come through translation unchanged. A native speaker writes or checks every non-English message. An empty text means the message isn't written yet: write it from draft_en, the English meaning, keeping the values in must_keep_numbers exactly as written. The test skips messages with empty text.

messages.text: Ngingafika ngoLwesibili, R450.
messages.notes: Demo step 4 wording from the build plan. Needs a native-speaker check.

messages.text: I-geyser yami iyavuza, amanzi agcwele yonke indawo. Ungakwazi ukuza namuhla?
messages.draft_en: My geyser is leaking, water is everywhere. Can you come today?
messages.notes: Customer's first job description. Use the everyday word for geyser (igiza).

messages.text: Ngingayilungisa ngoR1200 , kukhona namaparts
messages.draft_en: I can fix it for R1 200, parts included.
messages.notes: Price with a space as the thousands separator.

messages.text: Ngizoba khona ngo-10:30 kusasa ekuseni.
messages.draft_en: I'll be there at 10h30 tomorrow morning.
messages.notes: South African 10h30 time format.

messages.text: Impompi yasekhishini ayiyeki ukuvuza.
messages.draft_en: The tap in the kitchen won't stop dripping.
messages.notes: Plumbing. Mix in the English word 'tap' if that's how people say it.

messages.text: Ugesi uhlale ucisha uma ngivula iketela
messages.draft_en: The electricity keeps tripping when I switch on the kettle.
messages.notes: Electrical. Use ugesi for electricity.

messages.text: Ngidinga ukushintshwa kwepayipi elingu-15mm ngaphansi kosinki.
messages.draft_en: I need a 15mm pipe replaced under the sink.
messages.notes: Measurement must survive. Use ipayipi for pipe.

messages.text: Ungakwazi yini ukuza ngomhla ka-29/09 ngo-2 ntambama?
messages.draft_en: Can you come on 29/09 at 2pm?
messages.notes: Date and time in one message.

messages.text: Kubiza u-R350 ukuze beze lapho ukhona, besekuba u-R200 ngehora ngemuva kwalokho.
messages.draft_en: It costs R350 for the call-out and R200 per hour after that.
messages.notes: Two prices: they must not swap places.

messages.text: Ngihlala e-12 Protea Street, endlini enesango eliluhlaza.
messages.draft_en: I live at 12 Protea Street, the house with the green gate.
messages.notes: Address must survive (the app only sends this after the job is confirmed).

messages.text: Ngiyaxolisa,sengisele emuva ngesikhathi ,ngizobe ngilapho emizuzwini engu-20.
messages.draft_en: Sorry, I'm running late, I'll be there in 20 minutes.
messages.notes: Write it the way people really text, mixing in English words if natural.

messages.text: Indlu yangasese ivalilekile futhi amanzi aphumela phansi.
messages.draft_en: The toilet is blocked and water is coming out onto the floor.
messages.notes: Urgent plumbing.

messages.text: Imitha yami ekhokhelwa kusengaphambili ikhombisa ukuthi khukhona inkinga,izibani azikhanyi.
messages.draft_en: My prepaid meter says there's a fault, the lights won't come on.
messages.notes: Electrical. Prepaid meters are common in the townships.

messages.text: Sengineminyaka engu-8 ngenza lo msebenzi, ngingathumela izithombe zemisebenzi yami.
messages.draft_en: I've done this work for 8 years, I can send photos of my jobs.
messages.notes: Tradesperson describing experience.

messages.text: Uphahla luyavuza uma kuna imvula, ngaphezu kwegumbi lokulala.
messages.draft_en: The roof leaks when it rains, above the bedroom.
messages.notes: Roofing.

messages.text: Intengo yami yokugcina ingu-R2 500 futhi ngizoqeda ngoLwesihlanu.
messages.draft_en: My final price is R2 500 and I finish on Friday.
messages.notes: Quote with a day. Write the price as 'R2 500'.

messages.text: Ngiyabonga ,umsebenzi wenziwe kahle. Ngizophinde ngikushayele ucingo.
messages.draft_en: Thank you, the job was done well. I'll call you again.
messages.notes: Customer thanking after the job. Tests tone, not values.

messages.text: Ngicela ungithumele idiphozithi engu-R500 kuqala ngaphambi kokuba ngize.
messages.draft_en: Please send me a deposit of R500 first before I come.
messages.notes: A scam-shaped message: scan_message should warn about upfront payment. The translation must still be accurate.

messages.text: I-geyser yam iqhushumbe ngale ntsasa, nceda undincede.
messages.draft_en: My geyser burst this morning, please help.
messages.notes: isiXhosa version of an urgent plumbing job.

messages.text: Ndingeza ngoLwesithathu ngo-9:00, kuza kubiza ama-R600.
messages.draft_en: I can come on Wednesday at 9:00, it will cost R600.
messages.notes: isiXhosa quote with a time and a price.

messages.text: Akukho mbane kwisiqingatha sendlu.
messages.draft_en: There's no electricity in half of the house.
messages.notes: Electrical. Use umbane for electricity.

messages.text: Umbhobho wangaphandle waphukile kwaye amanzi abaleka esiya esitratweni.
messages.draft_en: The pipe outside is broken and water is running into the street.
messages.notes: Plumbing.

messages.text: Uxolo, andikwazi ukuza namhlanje. Singenza ngomhla wesi-3 ku-Okthobha?
messages.draft_en: I'm sorry, I can't come today. Can we do 3 Oct?
messages.notes: Rescheduling. Keep the date written as '3 Oct'.

messages.text: Ndidinga umntu oza kupeyinta amagumbi amabini,malunga ne-R1,800?
messages.draft_en: I need someone to paint two rooms, about R1,800?
messages.notes: Painting. Price with a comma as the thousands separator.

messages.text: Hi, my geyser is leaking. Can you come tomorrow at 10:00?
messages.notes: English customer to an isiZulu-speaking plumber. Check the geyser word in the translation.

messages.text: R450 is fine. Please bring the parts with you.
messages.notes: Customer accepting the demo quote.

messages.text: The gate code is not needed, just knock. I'm at 45 Jacaranda Road.
messages.notes: Address after confirmation.

messages.text: Can you also check the wiring in the kitchen while you're here? I'll pay R300 extra.
messages.notes: Extra work mid-job.

messages.text: My toilet is blocked. When can you come?
messages.notes: English customer to an isiXhosa-speaking plumber.

messages.text: Thanks, see you on Saturday at 8am. The price was R750, right?
messages.notes: Confirming the booking. The time should come out with the isiXhosa word for morning (ntseni), not "am".
